olivia.m: FYI postmortem up for Jan metering duplication. Summarizing action items here so finance ops has a single tracker.
raj.p: TL;DR?
olivia.m: Consumer restart caused replayed batches; dedupe missed due to offset race. ~420k duplicated tokens across 2 customers, invoices Jan 20.
kate.z: Who's on credits + timeline?
olivia.m: BILL-5100 assigned to billing-ops (kate.z). Target: credits issued within 48h.
billing-bot: Task BILL-5100 created: "Crediting + invoice reissue for Jan 20 duplication" assigned kate.z due 2026-02-02.
ops-bot: Task INF-1012 created: "consumer commit ordering fix" assigned raj.p due 2026-02-05.
kate.z: Backfill plan: snapshot -> dedupe by event_hash -> compute deltas -> issue credits. I'll save snapshot to s3://billing-backups/2026-01-20-snap.json.gz and attach audit CSV to ticket.
raj.p: Will add integration test for replay and push PR in 36h. Also adding alert: consumer-lag > 10m -> page.
olivia.m: Legal suggested goodwill credits for >$250 impact. Kate please include legal-approved template in CRM.
kate.z: Will do. QA checklist: snapshot taken, staging dedupe run, reconcile CSV, sample invoice PDFs validated, credits posted, customers emailed.
billing-bot: BILL-5100 status: credits queued for acct X321.
olivia.m: Daily check-in here at 08:00 PST until closed. If any slip >24h escalate to finance lead.
raj.p: Adding longer-term fixes: event_id dedupe index + commit-on-ack semantics. Logged in risk registry.
kate.z: After credits posted I'll update action table and close ticket. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
